1.t: By the (steeds) that run, with panting.

2.t: Striking sparks of fire (by their hooves).

3.t: And scouring to the raid at dawn.

4.t: And raise the dust in clouds the while.

5.t: And penetrating forthwith as one into the midst (of the foe).

6.t: Verily, man (disbeliever) is ungrateful to his Lord.

7.t: And to that he bears witness (by his deeds).

8.t: And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.

9.t: Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are poured forth (all mankind is resurrected)?

10.t: And that which is in the breasts (of men) is made known?

11.t: Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds and will reward them for their deeds).
